applicability: The Intent review control in a leaf task document's change-set bar in the dashboard DetailPanel, for live and closed leaves.
conditions: The bar is rendered for a leaf task document with an onOpen handler wired.
A live leaf's control opens the live candidate comparison; a closed leaf's opens its recorded comparison and is labelled (recorded).
Intent counts, file attribution and open-work counts are separate summary facts; absent open-work data is omitted and is not inferred as zero.
exclusions: The reviewer surface's own subject navigation and refresh control.
The committed and working change-set buttons, which keep their line totals.
An all-answered display is the supplied summary fact, not independent memory, code, or lifecycle acceptance.
statement: A leaf task entry has one Intent review control with changed-intent +N −N counts and a recorded label for a closed leaf. Its separate attribution text says files without an invariant, unknown attribution, partial or unavailable as supplied; zero file counts add no attribution suffix. When the summary supplies an open-work count, the same control separately states N open or all answered. It has no subject picker or refresh control and opens the task-context target.
